name: Paddock
role: Medora old-timer; stock association committeeman and gun club member
bio: Paddock was a Medora old-timer who in March 1884 sat on the committee of five drafting by-laws for the Bad Lands Live Stock Association, and whose boar was matched against Pennell & Roberts' bears for a $50-a-side fight that April. He shot with the Bad Lands Gun Club in 1885 and came back from a late-November 1885 hunt with Fisher and McGregor bringing thirteen deer and eighty-five prairie chickens.

There will be fun for the boys on April 5, when Pennell & Roberts' bears and Paddock's boar get at each other. Fifty dollars a side is up, but as the stockmen will be here on the day of the fight, considerable money will change hands.
The Bad Lands Gun Club Shoot.
The hunting party we spoke of last week, consistsng of Messers Fisher, Paddock and McGregor, came back laden with thirteen deer and eighty-five prairie chickens.
